tools.name: markets
tools.title: The shelf
tools.description: Every stock on Borro and the USDG vault: price, what is lent, borrowed and free to short, what lenders earn and what shorters pay a year (one number each, $BORRO included once it has been paid), the USDG borrowing rate against each stock, and the $BORRO Drip to lenders: dollars a day per pool at today's price, and the rate a deposit of a given size would get.

tools.name: position
tools.title: A wallet on Borro
tools.description: Everything a wallet has on Borro: stock lent, shorts (owed, money held, the price it is closed for you at, and parts: how much of the stock's one short is the wallet's own, a pair's and a basket leg's), USDG loans, USDG lent, open pairs (each with short_now, its own part of the short), gap covers bought and its part of the gap cover pool, options held, written and on order (with what to do next and one yearly number for premiums over what they locked), bear coins it launched, $BORRO to claim, its locker rebates (the share of Borro's fees it gets back for its $BORRO lock, what is owed and what has been paid), and its ETH and USDG.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

tools.name: open_short
tools.title: Prepare: open a short
tools.description: Unsigned transactions to short a stock from the wallet: approve the deposit if needed, then BorroShort.open (borrow the stock, sell it, hold the money plus the deposit). Priced now, with half a percent of slip allowed; simulated from the wallet. The quote's rebate_estimate is what this short puts in the wallet's weekly locker rebate.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

amount.description: Stock to short, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

deposit.description: USDG to add to the money held, beyond the sale (optional, default 0), in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

tools.name: close_short
tools.title: Prepare: close a short
tools.description: Unsigned transactions to close the wallet's short on a stock: buy back everything owed, return it, take out the money held (with a USDG top-up approval if it is under water). A wallet has one short per stock, shared by any pair or basket legs on it: this closes all of it, and closes_parts lists the parts it takes with it. close_pair closes only a pair's own part.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

tools.name: supply
tools.title: Prepare: lend
tools.description: Unsigned transactions to lend a stock to shorters (it earns lending fees) or USDG in the Borro USDG vault (it earns interest). With post: true, a stock is lent and posted in one step so USDG can be borrowed against it.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

amount.description: Amount to lend, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

post.description: Stock only: lend and post as collateral in one step

tools.name: withdraw
tools.title: Prepare: take back what is lent
tools.description: Unsigned transaction to take back lent stock or USDG (part, or all with all: true). Stock on loan to shorters comes back once it is returned.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

amount.description: Amount to take back, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

tools.name: bind_builder
tools.title: Prepare: credit a bookrunner for borrowing
tools.description: Credits a bookrunner's code with the wallet's borrowing on Borro (Bookrunners): the bookrunner earns Borro's own fee on the interest the wallet pays, all of it for 12 months, half after; the wallet pays nothing more. Without signature: EIP-712 typed data for the wallet to sign (eth_signTypedData_v4, no transaction, no gas), good for 10 minutes. With signature and that timestamp: submits it, the same as POST https://borro.markets/builders/bind. One code per wallet; the first binding stands.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

code.description: The bookrunner's code, as in borro.markets/?ref=<code>

timestamp.description: With signature: the timestamp from the typed data that was signed

signature.description: The wallet's EIP-712 signature, 0x and 130 hex characters; leave out to get the typed data

tools.name: buy_with_eth
tools.title: Prepare: pay with ETH
tools.description: Unsigned transaction swapping the wallet's ETH for USDG or a stock on Uniswap, or through Route (route.fun) for a stock bought exact in when Route guarantees more (no Borro contract, no Borro fee), for the flows that need them.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

amount.description: How much of it to get, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

slip_bps.description: Most the price may move, in hundredths of a percent (default 100, 1%)

tools.name: open_long
tools.title: Prepare: leveraged long
tools.description: Unsigned transactions for a leveraged long on a stock in one open: USDG margin plus a flash-borrowed debt buy the stock, which is lent (it earns lending fees) and posted, and the debt is borrowed against it in the wallet's own name. Approve the margin and authorize LeverRouter on Morpho if needed, then open. Leverage up to 1.80x on SPY, QQQ and NVDA, 1.35x on the rest.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

margin.description: USDG margin from the wallet, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

tools.name: close_long
tools.title: Prepare: close a leveraged long
tools.description: Unsigned transaction closing all or part of the wallet's leveraged long on a stock: the stock is sold, the debt repaid, and the rest comes back in USDG.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

percent.description: How much of the position to close, 1 to 100 (default 100)
